display.name: Invoice Processing
display.description: Reads a supplier invoice from a PDF or photo and creates an unpaid bill in QuickBooks Online. New vendors, possible duplicates and bills over your limit wait for approval.

input.title: Invoice
input.description: The supplier invoice: a PDF, or a JPEG or PNG photo.

requiredConnections.purpose: Looks up vendors, accounts and bills, and creates vendors and unpaid bills.

setup.title: Approval limit
setup.description: Bills over this amount wait for an owner or admin to approve. 500 when left empty.

setup.title: Expense account
setup.description: The QuickBooks expense account for these bills, as QuickBooks shows it, without its number. For a sub-account: Parent:Child.

setup.title: Also email
setup.description: An address outside your workspace, such as your bookkeeper, that gets a short summary of each bill.

pipeline.title: Invoice received
pipeline.description: A person starts the run with a PDF or photo of the invoice. The file is checked before anything is spent.

pipeline.title: Check the QuickBooks company
pipeline.description: Confirms QuickBooks is connected and the company is a US company.

pipeline.title: Read QuickBooks settings
pipeline.description: Reads the home currency, the multicurrency setting and the closing date of the books.

pipeline.title: Find the expense account
pipeline.description: Finds the expense account named in this flow's settings.
